dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 18, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**MLB Recap: Pirates' Dominance Continues**

The Pittsburgh Pirates continued their winning streak, defeating the Cleveland Guardians 7-1. Jared Jones shone on the mound, tossing 5.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and just 1 earned run. Jacob Gonzalez led the Pirates' offense with 2 hits, including a home run and 2 RBIs. Brandon Lowe and Bryan Reynolds also had impressive performances for the Guardians.

In the late game, the Chicago Cubs defeated the Minnesota Twins 6-2, thanks in part to Kody Clemens' 2-home run performance. Taj Bradley took the loss for the Twins.

The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the New York Mets 6-1, with Jesús Luzardo pitching 5.0 strong innings and Trea Turner hitting a home run. The Toronto Blue Jays edged the Chicago White Sox 1-0, with Shane Bieber throwing a gem on the mound.

The Colorado Rockies crushed the Cincinnati Reds 10-3, with Jose Trevino hitting 2 home runs. The Baltimore Orioles outlasted the Houston Astros 4-2, thanks to Trevor Rogers' 6.1 innings of work.

The Kansas City Royals defeated the San Diego Padres 6-1, with Lane Thomas hitting a home run. The Arizona Diamondbacks edged the St. Louis Cardinals 5-3, with Jimmy Crooks hitting a home run. The Boston Red Sox came from behind to defeat the Tampa Bay Rays 7-6, with Wilyer Abreu hitting 2 home runs.

The Texas Rangers edged the Atlanta Braves 7-6 in a back-and-forth game. The Milwaukee Brewers defeated the Miami Marlins 8-6, with Griffin Conine hitting a home run. The Seattle Mariners edged the San Francisco Giants 4-3, with Cole Young hitting a home run.

The Oakland Athletics trounced the Washington Nationals 15-1, with J.T. Ginn pitching 6.1 shutout innings. The Detroit Tigers shut out the Los Angeles Angels 7-0, with Tarik Skubal tossing a complete game shutout.
